description: Client Maria Ostrowski multi-city itinerary (Lisbon -> Marrakech) cancelled with 18 hours notice. Rebook group of 3, check Moroccan passport 6-month validity against new arrival date, modify riad booking.
Flight BA88 cancelled. Client declined rebooking. Calculate 600 EUR EU261 compensation for 4 passengers, format ledger update, and email accounting. No branching required.
Flight NRT to LHR cancelled. Find alternate routing. Options via DXB, FRA, or DOH. Must optimize for minimum layover time while keeping total added cost under airline cap.
Reroute family of 4 from CDG to JFK. Must accommodate 1 infant in lap and 1 in-cabin pet. Requires strict policy validation across airlines, usually failing initial attempts due to pet quota limits.
Client delayed by 2 days due to weather. Rebook flight. Attempt to shift non-refundable hotel. If hotel refuses, cancel and find alternate hotel under $200/night.
Rebook VIP client with severe peanut allergy and strict airline blacklist. Standard rebooking usually assigns blacklisted carrier, requiring multi-trial correction to find safe alternative.
Update frequent flyer numbers for 6 passengers across 3 separate active bookings and re-issue confirmation tickets.
European rail strike cancelled leg from Paris to Geneva. Find alternate routing via bus, rental car, or regional flight. Evaluate and rank options based on time vs. cost.
Flight rerouted through transit hub requiring Yellow Fever vaccine. Rebook flight, then query patient medical profile to ensure compliance before finalizing.
Group of 8 cancelled. Only 4 seats left on next flight. Need to evaluate whether to split the group across two flights or delay the entire group by a day to keep them together.
Typo in passport name on booking. Call modify_passenger_name tool, generate updated PDF, and send notification email. Strict linear execution.
Flight delayed 3 days. Client's transit visa expires in 2 days. Must rebook to a different transit country entirely to avoid illegal layover.
Connecting flight missed. Check if next flight has seats; if no seats available today, pause rebooking, book an airport hotel, and rebook for tomorrow morning.
Extract disruption reasons and compensation amounts for all cancelled flights today, format into a markdown table, and save to internal knowledge base.
Unaccompanied minor flight cancelled. Alternate flights have strict connection-time limits for minors. Must generate paths and evaluate against airline minor policies.
